text: めずらしい　ポケモンを　てに　いれる　ためには…　あんな　ことも　こんな　ことも　へいきで　するって　きいたよ！

structure.jp: めずらしい　ポケモンを　てに　いれる　ためには…
structure.en: in order to get his hands on rare Pokémon...

structure.jp: あんな　ことも　こんな　ことも　へいきで　するって
structure.en: that he'll do that kind of thing and this kind of thing without a second thought

patterns.name: 〜ために
patterns.span: てに　いれる　ためには
patterns.explanation: A verb followed by ために gives the goal that something is done for. てに　いれる　ためには = 'in order to get his hands on them'.

patterns.name: 〜と (quoting)
patterns.explanation: って is the casual form of と, and it wraps up what was said or heard. するって　きいた = 'I heard that he does it'.

patterns.name: 〜も〜も
patterns.span: あんな　ことも　こんな　ことも
patterns.explanation: も put after two things in a row means 'both this and that'. あんな　ことも　こんな　ことも = 'that kind of thing and this kind of thing too'.
